title: fix(deps): pin marshmallow<4 and flask-limiter<3.13 for compatibility
body:
### SUMMARY

Adds explicit version constraints to prevent two known install-time breakages:

1. **marshmallow ≥4** removed support for extra kwargs in `Field.__init__()`, raising `TypeError: Field.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'minLength'` when Superset schema modules are loaded ([upstream: apache/superset#33162](https://github.com/apache/superset/issues/33162)).

2. **flask-limiter 3.13** (yanked) and **4.x** moved `flask_limiter.wrappers` to an internal namespace, causing `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'flask_limiter.wrappers'` via flask-appbuilder's import of `RequestLimit` ([upstream: alisaifee/flask-limiter#479](https://github.com/alisaifee/flask-limiter/issues/479)).

Constraints are applied in two layers:
- `pyproject.toml` — enforced at `pip install` time
- `requirements/base.in` — enforced when regenerating the lockfile with `uv pip compile`

The pinned lockfiles (`base.txt`, `development.txt`) already resolve to compatible versions (`marshmallow==3.26.2`, `flask-limiter==3.12`), so no lockfile changes are needed.

Closes #2

### BEFORE/AFTER SCREENSHOTS OR ANIMATED GIF
Not applicable — dependency constraint change only.

### TESTING INSTRUCTIONS
1. `pip install -e .` (or `pip install apache-superset`) in a clean venv — verify that marshmallow 3.x and flask-limiter 3.12 are resolved.
2. `superset fab create-app` / `superset run` — verify no `TypeError` or `ModuleNotFoundError` on startup.
3. `uv pip compile pyproject.toml requirements/base.in -o /dev/stdout | grep -E 'marshmallow|flask-limiter'` — verify constraints are respected.
